description: Business rules, SQL compliance rules (COMP-001 to COMP-010), application workflow rules, and Data Connect mapping rules for EBS Intelligence Hub v5.1. Rules sourced from bob ontology guide.txt Section AD (SQL Compliance Rules) and Section AE (Named Individuals).

rules.description: All _ALL tables must include AND org_id = :p_org_id or MO_GLOBAL filter to prevent cross-org data leakage
PER_PEOPLE_F is a DateTrack table — must filter SYSDATE BETWEEN effective_start_date AND effective_end_date to get current record only
rules.sql_pattern: FROM PER_PEOPLE_F without effective date filter

rules.description: PER_ASSIGNMENTS_F must filter PRIMARY_FLAG='Y' to get the primary assignment only, plus effective date range
rules.correction: AND a.primary_flag = 'Y' AND SYSDATE BETWEEN a.effective_start_date AND a.effective_end_date

rules.description: AP_INVOICES_ALL should normally exclude cancelled invoices unless the query specifically needs them
rules.sql_pattern: FROM AP_INVOICES_ALL without AND cancelled_date IS NULL

rules.description: AP_CHECKS_ALL should normally exclude void cheques unless specifically needed
rules.sql_pattern: FROM AP_CHECKS_ALL without AND void_date IS NULL

rules.description: GL_CODE_COMBINATIONS should filter summary_flag='N' AND enabled_flag='Y' to exclude summary accounts
AP_EXPENSE_REPORT_HEADERS_ALL SOURCE column must be filtered to include only iExpense records, not all AP expense reports
SELECT * retrieves all columns including BLOBs — breaks if table structure changes and prevents index-only scans
SELECT (SELECT ...) in column list executes once per row — N+1 performance issue on large tables
rules.correction: Use a JOIN or WITH clause CTE instead

rules.description: EXECUTE IMMEDIATE with string concatenation creates SQL injection vulnerability — must use bind variables
rules.correction: EXECUTE IMMEDIATE sql_text USING bind_var1, bind_var2

rules.description: LIKE '%value' cannot use a B-Tree index — causes full table scan on potentially millions of rows
rules.correction: Use LIKE 'value%' or Oracle Text full-text search

rules.description: NOT IN (SELECT ...) returns zero rows if the subquery contains any NULL — use NOT EXISTS instead
ROWNUM is applied before ORDER BY — results in wrong top-N rows. Use FETCH FIRST or subquery pattern
rules.sql_pattern: WHERE ROWNUM <= N ORDER BY col
rules.correction: SELECT * FROM (...ORDER BY col) WHERE ROWNUM <= N

rules.description: Prefer FND_LOOKUP_VALUES_VL (language-aware view) over FND_LOOKUPS for multilingual environments. If the base table FND_LOOKUP_VALUES is queried instead, filter language = USERENV('LANG')
Oracle EBS standards require a comment header with Program Name, Author, Version, Description
AP_CHECKS_ALL should exclude void cheques using AND void_date IS NULL unless the query specifically reports on void payments
rules.sql_pattern: FROM AP_CHECKS_ALL without AND void_date IS NULL

rules.description: In MOAC-enabled environments use MO_GLOBAL.GET_CURRENT_ORG_ID() or MO_GLOBAL.SET_POLICY_CONTEXT to ensure correct ORG_ID rather than hardcoding values
For historical HRMS queries (as-of a specific date) use :p_as_of_date BETWEEN effective_start_date AND effective_end_date rather than SYSDATE to get the record as it existed on that date
rules.sql_pattern: SYSDATE BETWEEN eff_start AND eff_end in historical context

rules.description: Exclude FINALLY CLOSED POs from active PO queries using AND closed_code != 'FINALLY CLOSED' unless the query explicitly reports on closed POs
rules.sql_pattern: FROM PO_HEADERS_ALL without FINALLY CLOSED exclusion

rules.description: RA_CUSTOMER_TRX_ALL should filter complete_flag = 'Y' for fully completed AR transactions in standard reporting
AR_PAYMENT_SCHEDULES_ALL must filter status NOT IN ('CL','VOID') to exclude closed and voided transactions from outstanding balance reporting
GL_BALANCES must filter actual_flag to avoid mixing actuals, budgets, and encumbrances. Use A=Actual, B=Budget, E=Encumbrance
MTL tables use organization_id (not org_id) for inventory organization scoping. Missing this filter returns all organizations data
rules.sql_pattern: FROM MTL_* table without AND organization_id

rules.rule_name: Use BULK COLLECT for Large Data Sets
rules.description: Cursor FOR LOOP with individual row processing on large Oracle EBS tables (>1000 rows) causes context switch overhead. Use BULK COLLECT with FORALL for 10x-100x performance improvement
rules.sql_pattern: FOR rec IN (SELECT ... FROM large_table) LOOP single row DML FORALL not used
rules.correction: FETCH cur BULK COLLECT INTO l_table LIMIT 1000; FORALL i IN l_table.FIRST..l_table.LAST

rules.description: PL/SQL procedures making DML changes must have explicit COMMIT/ROLLBACK with proper exception handler. Missing exception handling leaves transactions in uncommitted state
rules.sql_pattern: INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE in PL/SQL without EXCEPTION handler and ROLLBACK
rules.correction: EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN ROLLBACK; RAISE_APPLICATION_ERROR(-20001, SQLERRM);

rules.rule_name: WHO Columns Required in Custom Tables
rules.description: All custom Oracle EBS tables (XXCUST_*) must include WHO columns: CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN. Required for Oracle support and audit compliance
rules.sql_pattern: CREATE TABLE xxcust_* without WHO columns
rules.correction: CREATED_BY NUMBER NOT NULL, CREATION_DATE DATE NOT NULL, LAST_UPDATED_BY NUMBER NOT NULL, LAST_UPDATE_DATE DATE NOT NULL, LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN NUMBER

rules.rule_name: FND_GLOBAL Context Required for EBS APIs
rules.description: All Oracle EBS public APIs (hr_employee_api, AP_VENDOR_PUB, etc.) require FND_GLOBAL context to be set before calling. Missing context causes API failures or incorrect auditing
rules.sql_pattern: Call to HR_EMPLOYEE_API or AP_VENDOR_PUB without FND_GLOBAL.APPS_INITIALIZE

rules.rule_name: Use EXISTS Instead of IN for Subqueries
rules.description: WHERE col IN (SELECT ...) evaluates the entire subquery before the outer query. WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ...) stops at first match — significantly faster on large EBS tables
Employees cannot directly delete reports — must submit a delete request with reason and notes. Technical role approves or rejects.
window.confirm() is blocked on file:// protocol in some browsers — replaced with custom #deleteConfirmOverlay HTML modal
loadReport() checks DELETED_REPORTS[key] before loading — prevents ghost reopens of deleted reports via sidebar or chat
_isNonEBSPrompt() blocks non-EBS queries (Python, weather, general coding) — SQL Lab only serves Oracle EBS SQL
Credentials must not be displayed in the login HTML or browser console — removed in v5.0
